description: This source file defines the class DataRegistrationService within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Installer Util Service namespace. The class handles sending registration data to a remote server via an HTTP client, utilizing GuzzleHttp. It includes methods for initializing the HTTP client and for transmitting registration data, with error handling and logging.

classes.name: DataRegistrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for sending registration data to a remote server, utilizing Guzzle HTTP client, with error handling and logging

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Guzzle HTTP client with a base URI for registration, employing lazy loading

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data to the server via POST request if in production mode, with error handling and logging
